data.name: PurposeBody
data.value: You can deploy the DDI Registry software on your own infrastructure to run your own registry service. You might want to do this if you would like to provide your own delegation and resolution services, instead of relying on the DDI Alliance's registry service.

data.name: UpdateWebConfig
data.value: Update the Web.config file

data.name: UpdateWebConfigBody
data.value: In the Web.Config file at the root of your site, search for the "connectionStrings" element and update these to point to your database.

data.name: Step5
data.value: Step 5. Integrate with DNS

data.name: Step5Intro
data.value: The Ddi.Registry.ZoneWriter console application is used to integrate the contents of the DDI Registry's database with your DNS system. To use this, follow these instructions.

data.name: Step5Body
data.value: The ZoneWriter works be writing a bind-compatible zone file. This file can be used by both bind and ActiveDirectory.

data.name: ZoneWriterStep1
data.value: Update ZoneWriter's App.config file

data.name: ZoneWriterStep1a
data.value: Update the DdiRegistry connection string to point to your database

data.name: ZoneWriterStep1b
data.value: Under the Ddi.Registry.ZoneWriter.Settings element, update the following properties

data.name: BaseZoneDesc
data.value: The name of the root, authoritative zone for the registry system. To work with the DDI Registry system, leave as registry.ddialliance.org

data.name: MasterNameDesc
data.value: The hostname of your primary nameserver

data.name: NameserverDesc
data.value: A list of hostnames of your nameservers

data.name: DefaultARecordDesc
data.value: The A record for the hostname specified in the BaseZone setting

data.name: ZoneFileLocationDesc
data.value: The location where your zone file will be written.

data.name: ZoneWriterStep2
data.value: Schedule the ZoneWrite to run on a regular basis (e.g., every 5 minutes).

data.name: ZoneWriterStep3
data.value: Set your DNS Server to use the zone file for its configuration.
